meta.name: Hotel Inhumans
meta.description: The best hotels must meet certain standards, including the finest cuisine, ways to relax, and entertainment. Of course, they also need the best selection of weapons, reliable ways to falsify one's identity, and ways to dispose of evidence. In this hotel at the border of death stand two concierges, Ikuro Hoshi and Sara Haizaki. What kinds of requests will the assassins have for them next?

videos.title: Sister Sister
videos.overview: A wounded man flees to Hotel Inhumans, where they cater to a certain clientele and the concierges are skilled.

videos.title: Dying Service 1
videos.overview: Kase is a hitman who stays at the hotel when he escapes the life others believe he leads.

videos.title: Dying Service 2
videos.overview: Kase's wound is dire. As his consciousness fades, memories of his wife, and one last request, fill his mind.

videos.title: Corpse Reviver
videos.overview: Nina has been raised to kill. One night, at the hotel bar, she listens to her next target's newest song.

videos.title: Remember Me
videos.overview: A couple arrives at the hotel. As Ikuro offers to take their weapons, Sara stops him for a surprising reason.

videos.title: A Last Supper 2
videos.overview: Sara and Ikuro fight in their own ways for the sake of their guest, Ringo, as her condition quickly worsens.

videos.title: Spider
videos.overview: A reporter who specializes in scandals tails a gunman from a murder scene to a hotel that isn't on any map.

videos.title: Risk Management
videos.overview: An old man claiming to be a regular arrives at the hotel, but his last stay there was twenty years ago!

videos.title: Another Sky 1
videos.overview: Sniper Danica and spotter Chetana are a sought after team, but they first met when Danica was betrayed.

videos.title: Another Sky 2
videos.overview: Chetana has disappeared. Will Danica act to save her, or will she keep the promise they made to each other?

videos.title: Another Sky 3
videos.overview: Chetana finds out that Danica has been forced into a contract. Meanwhile, Danica and Palan prepare for a kill.

videos.title: Another Sky 4
videos.overview: Ikuro and Sara's rescue mission is not without consequences. Later, they return to their duties at the hotel.

videos.title: Piano Lesson 1
videos.overview: A teenaged hired killer stays at Hotel Inhumans while infiltrating a high school for a job.

videos.title: Piano Lesson 2
videos.overview: A teenaged hired killer learns about what it takes to play piano and what it takes to be a friend.

videos.title: A Sweet Job 1
videos.overview: There’s a new arrival at Hotel Inhumans, and a treasured companion goes missing.

videos.title: A Sweet Job 2, First Guest
videos.overview: Time is running out to find a treasured companion, and a first time guest makes a last minute booking.

videos.title: Follow-up
videos.overview: On her way home from cram school, a fourth grader gets help from a kind stranger.

videos.title: Don't Cry, Baby
videos.overview: Sara finds herself in a difficult situation after going to pick up a hotel guest.

videos.title: Motorcycle Diaries 1
videos.overview: Koshiba frequents a convenience store where the artistically inclined Hikaru works part time.

videos.title: Motorcycles Diaries 2
videos.overview: Hikaru is desperate to regain something she lost and she enlists Koshiba's help to recover it.
